visual_history.assessment:
- Floating / disconnected pieces: The render shows parts of the bookshelf floating above and below the main structure, resembling an "exploded view" rather than a coherent object.
- Misalignment: The shelves are not properly integrated into the side supports; some appear to be offset or shifted.
- These issues stem from incorrect origin manipulation and bounding box logic at the end of the previous script.

- Floating pieces: The components are all detached and hovering because they were scaled to half their intended size.
- Misalignment: Because of the scaling error, none of the shelves or side panels actually touch.
- Wrong proportions: The thickness and overall dimensions are halved due to a logic error in the vertex multiplication.
